question:
Choose the idiom / phrase that can substitute the highlighted group of words meaningfully.

He **studied till late at night** before his exam and it has paid off.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Burn the midnight oil"** means to stay up late working on a project or studying. (रात देर तक काम करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She had to** burn the midnight** **oil **to finish the report on time.
 
 
 
• **"He studied till late at night before his exam and it has paid off"** refers to putting in a lot of effort, often by staying up late, to achieve success. (रात देर तक पढ़ाई करना)
 
 
• **Example: **He burned the midnight oil to prepare for his final exams and aced them.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **See eye to eye** (आम सहमति होना): To agree fully with someone.

 
 
• **Example:** They see eye to eye on most political issues.
 
 
 
• **Run out of steam** (हिम्मत हार जाना): To lose energy or motivation to continue.
 
 
• **Example: **After working non-stop for hours, I ran out of steam and had to take a break.
 
 
 
• **Lose your marbles** (पागल हो जाना): To go insane or act irrationally.
 
 
• **Example:** If you keep working like this, you are going to lose your marbles.
